prompts.body:

**Sleeve text (very important):**

**Sweatshirt color(s):** pick one per shirt from {red|Đỏ / orange|Cam / sand|Cát / beige|Be / white|Trắng / sport grey|Xám sport / black|Đen / grey|Xám / light pink|Hồng nhạt / light blue|Xanh nhạt / dark chocolate|Nâu sô-cô-la đậm / brown|Nâu / maroon|Đỏ mận / carolina blue|Xanh carolina / forest green|Xanh rêu / military green|Xanh quân đội / navy|Xanh than}.

**Scene & props (flat-lay on soft neutral linen):** a woven round placemat under the sweatshirt, plus a few cozy props: {tortoiseshell glasses, small potted succulent, lit candle, a couple of blurred polaroid family photos, ceramic dish|Bộ ấm cúng gia đình / pine sprigs, dried orange slices, a lit candle, a small kraft paper gift tied with twine|Bộ quà Giáng sinh / a small wicker pumpkin, a few dried maple leaves, a dark red candle on a wooden holder|Bộ Halloween}. Arrange them tastefully around the sweatshirt(s).

Style: soft natural daylight, neutral white balance, true-to-life colors, no yellow or orange color cast, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, photorealistic cozy lifestyle product photography, Etsy-style. The embroidered design stays the clear focal point and remains faithful to the attached artwork.
Keep the bottom-right corner of the frame as plain, empty background surface — no props, no fabric edges, no strong texture there.

prompts.name: Chuyển ảnh 2D thành thêu (5 màu)
prompts.note: Dùng kèm artwork 2D đính kèm — chuyển thành design thêu máy tối đa 5 màu chỉ rồi mockup lên áo
prompts.body:
Convert the attached 2D flat artwork into a PRODUCTION-READY MACHINE EMBROIDERY design, then present it stitched onto a garment mockup.

STEP 1 — DIGITIZE INTO COLOR BLOCKS:
- Reduce the entire artwork to a MAXIMUM OF 5 SOLID THREAD COLORS. No gradients, no blends, no halftones, no anti-aliased soft edges — every area becomes one flat block of a single thread color with a hard boundary.
- Merge small tonal variations into the nearest block. Simplify fussy micro-detail that is smaller than 1.5mm and would be unstitchable.
- Thicken every thin line to a minimum 1.5mm satin-stitch column so it can be physically stitched; delete hairlines that are too fine.
- Every shape must be CLOSED and self-contained, sitting edge-to-edge with its neighbor block (butt-registered), never overlapping into mush.
- Total design size approximately 20cm wide — proportions and silhouette of the original artwork must remain recognizable and unchanged.

STEP 2 — ASSIGN STITCH TYPES PER BLOCK:
- Large interior areas = tatami / fill stitch, with the STITCH ANGLE ROTATED DIFFERENTLY for each adjacent block so light catches each panel differently and the block structure is clearly readable.
- Outlines, borders and all lettering = raised satin-stitch columns, 3-4mm wide, tightly packed diagonal thread passes, domed and glossy.
- Small accents, eyes and dots = dense satin blocks sitting slightly higher than the fill beneath them.
- Fine interior details = single-pass running stitch, broken and slightly wobbly, with individual needle penetration points visible.

STEP 3 — PHYSICAL REALISM:
- Embroidery sits 1.5-2mm proud of the fabric and casts a soft contact shadow.
- Visible seam line where two thread colors butt against each other.
- Ragged fringe of individual thread tips along the outer silhouette; fabric nap fibers slightly overlapping the edges.
- Strong directional specular sheen on polyester thread — some stitch rows bright, adjacent rows darker purely from thread direction.
- Slight fabric puckering and needle holes around the stitched block.

STEP 4 — MOCKUP PRESENTATION:
- Place the finished embroidery centered on the chest of a folded garment.
- Top-down flat lay on warm oak wood, soft natural window light from upper left, cozy seasonal props (ceramic mug, candle, dried leaves) softly out of focus.
- Photorealistic product photograph, shallow depth of field, neutral color grade, true-to-life colors, sharp macro texture on the embroidery.
- Keep the bottom-right corner of the frame as plain, empty background surface — no props, no fabric edges, no strong texture there.

Photorealistic product photo of three neatly folded crewneck sweatshirts stacked on a white table beside a window.

Three sweatshirts, one color each: {beige, black, brown|Be – đen – nâu / military green, sand, beige|Xanh quân đội – cát – be / navy, light blue, white|Xanh than – xanh nhạt – trắng / maroon, sand, beige|Đỏ mận – cát – be / forest green, military green, sand|Xanh rêu – xanh quân đội – cát / dark chocolate, brown, beige|Sô-cô-la đậm – nâu – be / light pink, white, sand|Hồng nhạt – trắng – cát / carolina blue, light blue, white|Xanh carolina – xanh nhạt – trắng / grey, sport grey, white|Xám – xám sport – trắng / black, grey, sport grey|Đen – xám – xám sport / red, maroon, sand|Đỏ – đỏ mận – cát / orange, brown, sand|Cam – nâu – cát}. Crisp aligned folds with visible ribbed cuff and collar texture, each layer slightly offset so all three lines of embroidery are visible. Mid-weight brushed cotton fleece, soft matte surface, subtle natural creasing.

SCENE
Minimal and clean. {Matte white tabletop, sheer white curtain and bright daylight behind. One chunky knit blanket in a woven basket at the far-left edge, out of focus. A fine gold chain necklace and a few small dried flower petals scattered on the table in the lower-left foreground. Nothing else in frame — no scissors, no thread spools, no plants, no packaging, no props.|Bàn trắng + rèm sáng + giỏ len / Light oak table, white linen cloth draped at the left edge, plain off-white wall behind. A single gold ring and a few dried petals in the foreground. Nothing else in frame — no scissors, no thread spools, no plants, no packaging, no props.|Bàn sồi + khăn linen + nhẫn vàng / White marble surface, a soft stripe of morning sunlight falling across the table, plain white wall behind with a faint window shadow. Nothing else in frame.|Thông + đèn + cam sấy quế / Matte white tabletop, one small ceramic jack-o-lantern pumpkin mug and a few dried autumn leaves at the far-left edge, out of focus. Nothing else in frame.|Cốc bí ngô + lá khô (Halloween)}

LIGHT & CAMERA
Soft natural window light from the left (unless the chosen scene specifies its own lighting), gentle directional shadows, no harsh highlights or blown-out areas. 50mm lens at f/2.8, sweatshirts sharp, background softly blurred. Neutral white balance, muted true-to-life colors, natural contrast, no HDR, no heavy retouching. Square 1:1, the stack fills most of the frame, with clear margin at the bottom-right corner. Keep the bottom-right corner of the frame as plain, empty background surface — no props, no fabric edges, no strong texture there.
